source_scope: Read local retrieved PRD/Blueprint snapshot; latest owner instructions override historical exclusions/requirements. No newly verified building-regulation minima.

numeric_policy.geometry: exact decimal/rational representation where supported; no solver epsilon legalizes real gap
numeric_policy.ranking: Pareto same-program protected-function comparisons; no compensatory total score

acceptance: A_overlap=0 and A_unowned=0 in exact arithmetic
Every positive-area leftover has independently verified function or declared valid nonhabitable purpose
A_functionally_unresolved=0; this is semantic region coverage, NOT requiring furniture or movement to cover every floor point
Label, rectangular ownership, hash and route alone cannot prove purpose
Separate actual routes entry->living, entry->dining, entry->WC, living->dining all reach usable destination
Forbidden swept-area intersections=0 under each applicable activity/door scenario
Width validated against source-owned actor/activity profile; 1.10m kitchen and 1.20m main route only comparison targets
At least one complete source-program sitting bundle with usable access/activities in connected public space
Dining and kitchen are not implicitly counted as sitting area
Component/neck evidence must prove use; no universal aspect ratio threshold exists in reviewed sources
Residual strips cannot enlarge claimed usable living without proof
Zero functionless dead ends and zero proved unnecessary bedroom-wrap corridors
For suspect long/wrapping corridors compare actual door orientation/layout alternatives under same program and hard constraints
Reject when validated alternative strictly reduces wasted circulation without degrading protected functional metrics; unresolved necessity blocks
No claim of global minimum from bounded alternative search
n means independent units, never bedrooms; preserve input n
Every bedroom fits source-bound bed, closet, activities and access without forbidden shrink
Program selected by whole-unit capacity; room inflation alone is not proof of useful capacity
No universal maximum bedroom area invented; disproportion requires same-program useful-public-space comparison
Use one coherent private access cluster where feasible; count cross-public/kitchen detours explicitly
Compare candidate with same-program alternatives using pair-distance vector and protected public function
No arbitrary fixed max distance; unresolved major separation is not passed by a label
R_service=100*A_bath_WC_union/A_unit_net; combined room counted once
Baseline is smallest actually validated same-service-program layout, not claimed theoretical minimum
Excess requires verified functional reason and alternative comparison; missing baseline=unknown
Do not shrink required activities to meet a percentage
Prove necessary common access and staging; merely leftover between stair and lift is not justified
Compare compact actual same-program alternative with preserved operational access
Balance unit access by comparing distance spread, not arbitrary equality tolerance
Full technical stair/elevator approval is excluded; geometric ownership and actual access remain in scope
In applicable plausible scenarios inappropriate view of protected bed/changing/WC/shower activity areas=0
Seeing a bedroom door alone is not failure
sight_only_wall_count=0 and unproven_wall_function_count=0
Every added wall has actual useful serviced space and measured remove/relocate comparison
Every opening belongs to actual host wall and correct adjacent regions; no orphan or facade-behind fake window
Door body, swept movement and usable access tested, not just arc symbol
Do not measure or claim daylight/ventilation sufficiency
Compare cooking->usable_dining route and everyday living connection to valid same-program alternatives
No invented mandatory work-triangle distance
Shortening route cannot sacrifice guest independence, bedroom grouping or usable living
Check all k*(k-1)/2 whole-plan pairs; 6 options requires15 comparisons
Renaming, recoloring, mirror-only and numerical jitter do not count as novelty
All required checks pass per unit; average score never hides one failing unit
Up to six, not guaranteed six; fewer/zero honestly reported

delivery: all mandatory applicable current-geometry rules PASS AND independent legacy technical gate PASS; UNKNOWN blocks. Reopen/select/export recheck same condition.

steps: choose bounded structural repair addressing reasons
rerun ALL applicable checks on new geometry
stop: two successive attempts without measurable verified improvement
proven incompatible constraints within stated scope
repair_loop.stop_result: NO_VALIDATED_SOLUTION_FOUND unless actual infeasibility proof; do not release last failed candidate
